div.div: 📚 Think of the school library. You fill out a request slip with the exact call number — say QA76.73 (the REQUEST). The librarian disappears into the stacks and brings back your book (the RESPONSE). You don't wander the shelves yourself — you ask and receive. Call number for a book that doesn't exist? 404 Not Found. Slip with no call number written on it? 400 Bad Request. The librarian brings a book and a date stamp — no small talk.

div.div: 💡 This is literally what app.run() does: an endless loop. When you click 'Stop' in PyCharm, you break the loop and the server shuts down.
